dimensions.assessment: Impacts Medicare beneficiaries receiving remote patient monitoring and healthcare providers, practitioners, and suppliers furnishing these services nationwide, particularly in rural regions.
dimensions.evidence: no payment may be made under this part for such monitoring furnished by a provider of services or supplier unless...

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a practice expense and malpractice index floor of 1.00 for remote patient monitoring and sets strict new eligibility rules for receiving Medicare payments.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall increase any such index to 1.00 if such index would otherwise be less than 1.00.

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits applying the geographic index floor in a budget-neutral manner, implying changes to Medicare payment totals and expenditure calculations.
dimensions.evidence: The preceding sentence shall not be applied in a budget neutral manner.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title XVIII of the Social Security Act by adding mandatory conditions for remote patient monitoring payment and establishing a payment floor.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1848(e)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w-4(e)(1)) is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph

dimensions.assessment: Implements permanent changes to Medicare payment calculation rules alongside a mandated four-year programmatic evaluation report.
dimensions.evidence: For purposes of payment for remote patient monitoring furnished on or after January 1, 2026...

importance_detail.rationale: The bill conditions Medicare payments for remote patient monitoring on specific real-time availability, electronic health record compatibility, and data reporting standards, while setting a geographic index payment floor. This directly alters Medicare reimbursement conditions and practice expense calculations for healthcare providers serving Medicare beneficiaries.
